messages:
Iris: dropped a fresh direction for run-history 'compact signature with inline diff' — the idea is show a tiny signature pill + a 1-line JSON preview, and a diff marker when the output changed since the last run. figma: https://figma.redwood/inline-diff-v1 :mag:
Noah: love the diff callout. question: how do we surface that change to screen readers without being noisy?
Sam: SR suggestion: announce on focus 'Tool call, translate_batch, preview collapsed, output changed since previous run'. keep it once-per-focus; don't auto-announce for list scrolled quick.
Iris: thinking of using a subtle yellow badge with tooltip 'Output changed' and a sr-only prefix on the card when applicable. also keyboard: Tab lands on card, Enter expands inline, then Arrow keys move through fields.
Noah: copy nit: for header use 'translate_batch \u00b7 210ms' — middle dot for density. for very long names ellipsize and provide full-name tooltip + sr-only full announcement on focus.
Sam: toggle idea: let users collapse diffs from the topbar (Run history: Show diffs toggle). persist per-user. default on for power users, opt-out for minimal UI.
Iris: kept a tiny JSON preview in the mock: ```json
{"name":"translate_batch","params":{"texts":["hola"],"target_lang":"en"}}
```
Noah: accessibility nit: 'Copy signature' must not be hover-only. provide a keyboard-visible button; also add a global shortcut (Shift+C) to copy the focused card's signature and announce 'Signature copied' in an assertive live region.
Sam: UX detail: when diff exists, we should allow a quick peek inline: a small toggle 'Show change' that momentarily expands a diff snippet without full schema expansion. label it 'Peek change' and ensure aria-controls + aria-expanded.
Iris: good call. also to reduce DOM we lazy-render diff content only when user peeks or expands. for performance, collapsed cards render minimal text and badges.
Noah: microcopy decision: primary action label = 'View full output', secondary = 'Copy signature', tertiary = 'Peek change' when applicable. keep labels consistent across Playground.
Sam: keyboard interaction pattern: Tab to card -> Enter to expand -> first field focus -> Esc to collapse. Peek change should be reachable via a small button after tabbing into actions; ensure it's focusable even if visually hidden until keyboard focus.
ux-bot: Figma updated: https://figma.redwood/inline-diff-v1 (v1) — comments: implement sr-only announcements, add peek toggle, persist diff toggle per-user.
Iris: thanks! I'll iterate and drop PNGs tomorrow. also adding a small poll: which default should we pick for 'Show diffs' on first run? reactions: :one: = on, :two: = off, :three: = smart (on for runs with regression).
